mina: TL;DR candidate: "v0.11.0 — faster streaming, smarter batching, and small SDK changes; see migration notes."
owsen: Pushing anchor/link fixes. Assign reviews: @mina @owen. If CI green, merge tomorrow 09:00 PT.
